newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Matav to be bourse listed Nov '97 - minister.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Matav to be bourse listed Nov '97 - minister.

text.p: Hungarian telecommunications company Matav is likely to be listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange and a substantial foreign bourse in November 1997, Transport and Telecommunications Minister Karoly Lotz said.
Lotz was quoted by the Hungarian MTI news agency as telling an economic forum on Wednesday that he expected 17 percent of Matav's shares to be listed in November next year.
Lotz did not specify further details but added that foreign companies have invested $2 billion in the Hungarian telecommunications sector in the past few years.
Deutsche Telekom and Ameritech together own 67 percent of Matav.
Matav said recently it was considering an international share offering but added that no final decision had been made.
The Financial Times of London reported earlier that Deutsche Telekom and Ameritech would sell a 16 percent stake, worth about $500 million, within the next 18 months.
